queries.policies: SELECT * FROM e2e_source_policies_v1 ORDER BY source_key
queries.cohort: SELECT a.source_key,p.state,COUNT(*) n,SUM(h.generation_id IS NOT NULL) managed FROM article_publications_p3 p JOIN articles a ON a.id=p.article_id LEFT JOIN e2e_generation_heads_v1 h ON h.article_id=p.article_id GROUP BY a.source_key,p.state
queries.heads: SELECT g.article_id,g.source_key,g.generation_id,g.generation_seq,g.expected_version_id,g.expected_publication_revision,g.expected_publication_state,p.version_id actual_version_id,p.revision actual_publication_revision,p.state actual_state,pr.state progress_state,o.status outbox_status,o.last_error_code,o.attempt_count,o.created_at,o.updated_at FROM e2e_generation_heads_v1 h JOIN e2e_generations_v1 g ON g.generation_id=h.generation_id LEFT JOIN article_publications_p3 p ON p.article_id=g.article_id LEFT JOIN e2e_generation_progress_v1 pr ON pr.generation_id=g.generation_id LEFT JOIN e2e_search_repair_outbox_v1 o ON o.generation_id=g.generation_id ORDER BY g.source_key,g.article_id
queries.verification: SELECT g.article_id,g.source_key,e.result,e.verified_at,e.evidence_document FROM e2e_generation_heads_v1 h JOIN e2e_generations_v1 g ON g.generation_id=h.generation_id JOIN e2e_verification_evidence_v1 e ON e.generation_id=g.generation_id ORDER BY e.verified_at
queries.verificationJobs: SELECT status,last_error_code,COUNT(*) n,MIN(updated_at) oldest_updated_at FROM e2e_verification_jobs_v1 GROUP BY status,last_error_code
queries.reservations: SELECT COUNT(*) missing_outbox FROM e2e_generation_heads_v1 h WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM e2e_search_repair_outbox_v1 o WHERE o.generation_id=h.generation_id)
queries.triggers: SELECT name,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='trigger' AND name LIKE 'e2e_%' ORDER BY name
queries.freshness: SELECT COUNT(*) published_heads,SUM(a.id IS NULL) missing_article,SUM(v.id IS NULL) missing_or_foreign_version,SUM(v.version_role IS NULL AND f.version_id IS NULL) legacy_freshness_missing,SUM(v.version_role IS NULL AND f.freshness<>'current') legacy_freshness_not_current FROM article_publications_p3 p LEFT JOIN articles a ON a.id=p.article_id LEFT JOIN article_content_versions_p3 v ON v.id=p.version_id AND v.article_id=p.article_id LEFT JOIN legacy_version_freshness_classifications_v4 f ON f.version_id=v.id WHERE p.state='published'
queries.authorizations: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e2e_core_write_authorizations_v1) core_authorizations,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e2e_commit_guards_v1) commit_guards

 and (old.id is not new.id or old.article_id is not new.article_id or old.revision is not new.revision or old.parent_version_id is not new.parent_version_id or old.content_hash is not new.content_hash or old.case_key is not new.case_key or old.slug is not new.slug or old.source_key is not new.source_key or old.jurisdiction is not new.jurisdiction or old.institution_name is not new.institution_name or old.content_type is not new.content_type or old.original_url is not new.original_url or old.canonical_url is not new.canonical_url or old.original_language is not new.original_language or old.original_title is not new.original_title or old.korean_title is not new.korean_title or old.original_published_at is not new.original_published_at or old.cleaned_text is not new.cleaned_text or old.summary_json is not new.summary_json or old.source_metadata is not new.source_metadata or old.error_metadata is not new.error_metadata or old.version_role is not new.version_role or old.source_anchor_version_id is not new.source_anchor_version_id or old.source_content_hash is not new.source_content_hash or old.enrichment_source_content_hash is not new.enrichment_source_content_hash or old.authority_evidence_hash is not new.authority_evidence_hash or old.source_snapshot_hash is not new.source_snapshot_hash or old.case_metadata_snapshot is not new.case_metadata_snapshot or old.case_identifiers_snapshot is not new.case_identifiers_snapshot)
begin select raise(abort,'e2e_core_immutable_version'); end
